command.name: security key-manager key key-table modify

parameter.name: key-id
parameter.description: This parameter specifies the key ID of the entry to be modified.

parameter.name: key-type
parameter.description: If this optional parameter is specified, the key type field is modified accordingly.

parameter.name: encryption-algorithm
parameter.description: If this optional parameter is specified, the encryption algorithm field is modified accordingly.

parameter.name: creation-time
parameter.description: If this optional parameter is specified, the creation time field is modified accordingly.
